jess (AE): Heads-up 10: NovaHealth asked for an 8-week pilot to validate case classification + triage summarization. They want a runnable plan ASAP: scope, success criteria, and whos on deck. Can SEs confirm availability?

tom (SE): I can cover week 0-4 for dataset ingest, prompt iterations, and evaluation. Expect ~8hrs/wk early then spike to 12-16hrs during integration. Need a sandbox org with API keys and a 2-GPU dedicated slot for perf weeks.

lia (Eng): I will own the perf workflows and deployment matrix (hosted FP16 vs dedicated int8). Need: model binary, PKL tokenizer, and representative batch sizes. Ill instrument latency histograms and end-to-end tracing.

jess (AE): Draft success criteria from customer: intent accuracy >= 0.90, Rouge-L summary >= 0.55, throughput >= 35 req/s sustained, P90 latency < 600ms, and cost per inference < $0.012/token. They also want a reproducible eval runbook.

harry (PS): On pricing: theyre sensitive. I can push a 6-week pilot discount on Dedicated if we get an LOI. For hosted, we can offer usage credits but that won't cover reserved perf runs.

maria (Security): NovaHealth flagged PHI concerns and asked for encryption-at-rest details, an SP list for services used, and our redacted SOC2 report. Also requesting whether Private deployment is an option and estimated lead time.

tom (SE): For evals, can they provide 100 labeled cases + 200 unlabeled for blind eval? Prefer a set with length distribution so we can tune cache behavior.

lia (Eng): Example perf command Ill run (will add to repo):
```
./bench/run_bench.sh --model redwood-v2 --mode dedicated --batch 4 --seq 600 --clients 16 --duration 600
```
Ill add KV-cache warmup and a cold-start pass.

jess (AE): Proposed timeline: week 0 = kickoff & legal/infra prep, week 1-3 = prompt tuning + eval iterations, week 4-5 = perf scale + A/B quantized variant, week 6-7 = cost modeling + reliability tests, week 8 = synthesis + exec summary. If we need to compress, call it out now.

harry (PS): I'll draft the pilot commercial term sheet today. Idea: 6 weeks dedicated discounted + 2 weeks optional extension at standard reserved rates. Will include a clause about data handling limits.

maria (Security): Private deployment estimate: 5-7 weeks from signed SOW (depends on network access and PKI). I can prepare partial questionnaire responses (encryption, key management, endpoints) by Wed. Need to know if they plan inbound connections or closed VPN.

tom (SE): Ownerships: Ill do prompt tuning + labeled evals. Lia does perf harness + infra. Harry handles commercial terms. Maria security artifacts. Jess owns customer comms and acceptance criteria signoff.

jess (AE): Blockers: 1) Legal needs to review NovaHealth DPA changes (they want a tighter data purge timeline). 2) Customer is asking about on-prem installer for air-gapped use; escalate if true.

lia (Eng): Quick question: do we include int8 quantized runs on the initial perf matrix? That will shift latency expectations; include both FP16 and int8 in the report.

harry (PS): Yes include both. For cost modeling include token-level and per-request amortized infra cost.

jess (AE): Resource ask: SE 8-12 hrs/wk weeks 0-4 then 6-10 hrs/wk weeks 5-8. Eng perf 18-24 hrs total across weeks 3-6. Security docs by Wed. Sales to provide kickoff slide deck.

tom (SE): Confirming availability. Ill create a short eval template for NovaHealth labels (JSONL schema).

maria (Security): Uploading SOC2 snapshot + partial answers to encryption Qs to secure share shortly.

harry (PS): Draft LOI and pilot SOW will be in Sarahs drafts folder by EOD for review. (cc: jess)

jess (AE): Action items recap:
- NovaHealth to send 100 labeled + 200 unlabeled cases (customer)
- Tom: eval template + baseline prompts (due end of week 2)
- Lia: perf harness + bench script + results template (due start week 4)
- Harry: pilot commercial + discount terms (EOD)
- Maria: SOC2 redacted + encryption answers (Wed)
- Jess: kickoff deck + legal loop on DPA (today)

calendar-bot: meeting created by jess (AE)  "NovaHealth pilot kickoff" Wed 9:30am PT (link: https://calendar.internal/meet/nh-456)

lia (Eng): I added a minimal runbook in the shared doc: https://redwood.internal/sales/novah-health-pilot  pls add any missing testcases.

tom (SE): Adding notes: prefer relaxed span match for Rouge-L-adj scoring on entities; report strict numbers in appendix.

jess (AE): Thanks all. Ill update NovaHealth after kickoff. If anything changes, @channel, ping with the blocker. :rocket:
